steps.content: You've been taken to a secret warehouse. Some bizarre weapon boxes have been cracked open forcefully, scattering around on the ground chaotically. The dozen of remaining thugs are all gathered here, discussing their exit plan.

steps.speaker: Remnant Red Falcon
steps.content: I quit. I wanna go back! I shouldn't have believed your crap, I shouldn't have even...

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: You can't shirk a job like this! Those who ran away last time all got buried by their own bosses. This is a job from <color=#fb9259>them</color>, and your only option is to get it done! We must destroy the Legion!

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: And don't forget the weapons, the weapons they gave us! More and stronger Mania weapons!

steps.speaker: Remnant Red Falcon
steps.content: What good do weapons do! A few hundred people came and now there are only a dozen of us left. Even if we have all the Mania weapons in the world, what are we supposed to do with them?!

steps.speaker: Remnant Red Falcon
steps.content: You've all seen it. God knows what got into that woman, she's not fazed by contamination at all this time! We can't win!

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: We still have the hostage. Zoya needs that person. We can at least...

steps.speaker: Remnant Thou Voodoos
steps.content: Inheritance... We still have the inheritance... The voodoo's will lies there. The path she takes is filled with traps. Thou Voodoos will bring divine punishment to them...

steps.speaker: Remnant Thou Voodoos
steps.content: Go to... the second downward well, the path closer to the inheritance... It's here...

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: ...Alright, alright.

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: That's our only option now. The inheritance lies down there. If we're lucky enough, we can still flip things around. Take the hostage and get going.

You're lying on the ground and trying hard to gather information. At the same time, you swallow the pain, silently feel the shackles within you, and feel the presence of the Sinners on the other end of the shackles.
The unusually strong one has already gone down. The other two are approaching in your direction. Luckily enough, one of them probably has spotted the traces you left behind.
You've won half the bet. As the Yagyu member has said, the underground situation has already gone out of Zoya's control. She's not going to waste time on you. She will certainly choose to go down.
Before she comes back, Earl must be standing guard by the elevator. He can't leave his commander alone, and he absolutely won't kill you now and let the commander be exposed to contamination.
As long as the two Sinners can find you, you'll still be on track. As you're thinking, your captors have come before you.

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: Get up! Gotta go!

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: You're lucky you're still useful to us, otherwise I would *******
He drags you up roughly. The argument and the fact of their loss are obviously annoying him.
You must try to buy time. You can't be moved yet, at least not before they find you. With this thought, you grit your teeth and force a smirk.

options: ...It's kind of embarrassing to get mad because you've lost.

steps.content: A punch lands hard on your head. The man in a suit has forgone all his grace. He grabs your collar and begins yelling.

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: ***** prick! You ******* lapdog of the Legion! Shut up! Shut up!

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: If it hadn't been for that stupid little trick you pulled on us, Yagyu's team wouldn't have been stopped there and gotten ruined by the Legion!

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: It's all your fault!! It's all your fault!! ****!
His eyes are bloodshot and his punches keep landing hysterically on your body one after another. He's taking out his rage from the loss on you.
Extreme pain makes you too weak to keep sensing, but your sanity remains. If he yells even more loudly, will the Sinners hear him?

options: Control yourself. Your life depends on your hostage now.

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: You ******! I'm gonna shoot you! ****!
Bang! With a huge blast, a black shadow jumps out behind you, charging at the man hitting you. He gets bounced off and hits a storage rack a few meters away, moaning.
The Nightmare is standing before you. Its shape makes it look like it's boiling. A low rumbling is flowing out from its core, as if it's raging.
Meanwhile, the girl's voice rings behind you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Please don't get hurt while I'm not around, Chief.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You've given me the order to stay beside you and protect you untill the end. If that's what you want, please always stay within my sight.
A pair of warm hands hold your back gently, supporting your body covered in wounds. You can finally relax.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You run too fast! Did you find the Chief?! Ah, ${PlayerName}, you...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the ****! Which bastard did this to you! Who did this!
